source: mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (f725369), the values of the supervisor's SSVEP pipeline; every value a starting draft the plan confirms or changes (G17 i). Frequencies, harmonics response, window and channels have NO default: from PARADIGM.md.

ssvep.stimulus_freqs_note: REQUIRED from PARADIGM.md: one frequency per class, in class order ([M] used 24, 20, 15, 10.9091, 8.5714 Hz for its study)

filterbank.bank_note: bank = the FBCCA bank of [M] (src/preprocessing/windowing.py fbcca_filter_bank: Chebyshev I, order 4, 3 dB, from 6/14/22 Hz to min(90, fs/2 - 1)); fbcsp_bank = [M] DEFAULT_SUBBANDS (Butterworth 4); the harmonic bank k*f +- 1 Hz (configs/pipeline_config.yaml l.41-42) is an alternative the plan may choose
filterbank.window_note: REQUIRED from PARADIGM.md (analysis window per trial, e.g. [0, 1] s after stimulus onset)

fbcca.response_multiple_note: 2 for pattern-reversal / checkerboard stimulation whose response is at twice the rate ([M] PF-39); from PARADIGM

f1.source: mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (f725369) get_sklearn_model_suite (the same 10 models as the erp profile); flagship FBCSP+FBCCA -> Shrinkage-LDA (scripts/benchmarks/benchmark_loso.py l.296-298)
f1.feature_spaces_note: raw = decimated 4-14 Hz epoch flattened channel-major (8 x 51 = 408); cca = the baseline's CCA spatial filter fitted in-fold (51 x 3 = 153)
f1.model_seed_source: [own]: the plan's fold seed 20261107 reused for the saga/SGD random_state (M default 42)

Ridge.source: values set in M: ['alpha', 'class_weight']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5)

LogReg L2.source: values set in M: ['C', 'class_weight', 'l1_ratio', 'max_iter', 'solver']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5)

LogReg L1.source: values set in M: ['C', 'class_weight', 'l1_ratio', 'max_iter', 'random_state', 'solver', 'tol']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5); random_state = f1.model_seed (M: seed argument, default 42) [own]

LogReg ElasticNet.source: values set in M: ['C', 'class_weight', 'l1_ratio', 'max_iter', 'random_state', 'solver', 'tol']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5); random_state = f1.model_seed (M: default 42) [own]

SGD log-loss.source: values set in M: ['alpha', 'class_weight', 'l1_ratio', 'loss', 'max_iter', 'penalty', 'random_state']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5); random_state = f1.model_seed (M: default 42) [own]

SGD PA.source: values set in M: ['eta0', 'learning_rate', 'loss', 'max_iter', 'penalty', 'random_state']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5); random_state = f1.model_seed (M: default 42) [own]; class_weight None as in M (M sets none for this model)

LDA svd.source: values set in M: ['priors', 'solver']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5); priors [0.5, 0.5] = equal priors as the baseline (D-005 item 3; plan F1); M leaves priors at the class proportions

Shrinkage-LDA lsqr.source: values set in M: ['priors', 'shrinkage', 'solver']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5); priors [0.5, 0.5] = equal priors as the baseline (D-005 item 3; plan F1); M leaves priors at the class proportions. F1 PRIMARY on raw features

Shrinkage-LDA eigen.source: values set in M: ['priors', 'shrinkage', 'solver']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5); priors [0.5, 0.5] as the baseline (D-005 item 3; plan F1); M leaves priors at the class proportions

QDA.source: values set in M: ['priors', 'reg_param']; every other parameter = scikit-learn 1.9.1 default, written out (G5); reg_param 0.5 as M; priors [0.5, 0.5] [own]: same reason as LDA (imbalance must not set the threshold)

f1.priors_note: REQUIRED: set priors of LDA/QDA to 1/k for the k classes (or as the plan decides); null is refused

fbcca.source: fs and frequencies from the header / PARADIGM (required); H 3, weights b^-1.25 + 0.25: [M] fbcca_extraction.py l.35, l.51 (Chen et al. 2015)
fbcca.n_bands_note: number of bands of ssvep.filterbank.bank (the FBCCA bank); the union input holds those bands first, then the fbcsp_bank bands

networks.description: MAS's P20 within-subject network protocol (v0.4.1): 1 s windows every 0.25 s inside each trial, 5 folds grouped by trial, MAS fit_network (inner grouped validation 20 %, patience 25, label smoothing 0.1, batch 16, no class weights), MAS augmentation ON, EEGNetSSVEP kernel fs // 2; trial score = mean of its windows' probabilities
networks.source: [M] ../mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (commit f725369) scripts/benchmarks/neural_networks/benchmark_nn_sweep.py l.1-21, l.98-150; src/models/cnn/training.py l.1-43, l.46-57, l.93-175; src/models/cnn/eegnet.py l.20-63; src/preprocessing/dataset/augmentation.py l.1-110. v0.4.0 cited training.py::fit_network but used whole trials, the study folds and augmentation OFF; that is not the protocol behind any MAS network result (corrected in v0.4.1)
networks.device_note: a configured CUDA device that is unavailable is an error, never a silent CPU fallback
networks.seeds_note: three seed bases spaced by 1000 (> networks.cv.n_splits), so seed base + fold never repeats across seeds (G18); per fold k the model, DataLoader, augmentation and inner validation split use seed base + k ([M] nn_sweep l.117, training.py l.104)

deterministic.source: plan F2 'deterministic cuDNN set'; PyTorch 2.13 Reproducibility notes (CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG required by use_deterministic_algorithms on CUDA)

eegnet.kernel_note: REQUIRED: fs // 2 of the network input ([M] training.py l.46-57; 128 at 256 Hz)
eegnet.source: [M] ../mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (commit f725369) training.py l.55-56 (eegnet = EEGNetSSVEP(F1 8, D 2, F2 16, kernel fs // 2, dropout 0.25)); eegnet.py l.20-63 (padding k // 2 and 8, max-norm 1.0 on the spatial filters only)

shallowconvnet.source: [M] ../mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (commit f725369) shallow_conv_net.py l.26-28 (P09 defaults, sized for 256 Hz). ShallowConvNet was not part of [M] P20: it has no P20 target

trainer.val_split: first split of StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=max(2, round(1/val_frac)), shuffle=True, random_state=fold seed) over the training windows, groups = trial uid [M training.py l.79-85]
trainer.val_seed: fold seed (seed base + fold), passed by network_windows.cv_network_windows
trainer.class_weights_rule: none: [M] fit_network uses no class weights (training.py l.93-155)
trainer.val_loss_note: validation loss = plain mean NLL, as [M] _loss_acc (training.py l.87-90)
trainer.normalisation: per channel: mean and std over all fitting epochs and time samples, std + norm_eps (M fit_stats); no per-epoch z-scoring (M's trainer does not do it)
trainer.restore: state with the lowest validation loss
trainer.source: [M] ../mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (commit f725369) src/models/cnn/training.py: BATCH_SIZE 16, LR 1e-3, WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01, ETA_MIN 1e-5, LABEL_SMOOTHING 0.1, VAL_FRAC 0.2, MAX_EPOCHS 150, PATIENCE 25, NORM_EPS 1e-6 (l.35-43), T_max = max_epochs (l.115), predict chunk 256 (l.69), min batch 2 (l.128); AdamW betas/eps/amsgrad = torch 2.13 defaults written out; val_seed and class weights from the plan

augmentation.note: ON, as [M] P20 (nn_sweep l.10: augmentation on by default); applied to the normalised fitting windows only
augmentation.source: [M] ../mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (commit f725369) src/preprocessing/dataset/augmentation.py l.1-110: order mixup -> scale -> shift -> noise, p 0.5 each, mixup within the class with lambda ~ Beta(0.4, 0.4) folded to max(lam, 1 - lam), scale U(0.9, 1.1), circular shift up to int(0.1 T), noise 0.05 x the window's per-channel std

null.rng: numpy.random.default_rng([seed, p]) per permutation p; block targets shuffled within each file (session_eval.draw_session_shuffles, the same draws as the first 20 of the F1 null); folds fixed; network refitted
null.reporting: descriptive only (null BA mean, sd, min, median, max per file and pooled, next to the observed BA of the same seed); no p-value (plan 'Statistics')
null.scope_note: [own] primary network and first seed only: 20 permutations x 8 folds = 160 fits

windows.source: [M] ../mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (commit f725369) benchmark_nn_sweep.py l.82-83 (window 1 s, stride 0.25 s); build_windows.py l.203-217 (stride = int(stride_sec * fs)); trial score = mean of its windows' softmax probabilities [own: MAS P20 reports window accuracy, the study unit is the trial]

cv.seed_note: REQUIRED: the study's folds seed (MAS: 42 + repeat)
cv.source: [M] ../mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (commit f725369) cv_utils.py l.96-99 (StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle)); nn_sweep l.106-110 (groups = true trial ids, no shared trial asserted)

statistics.participant_score: balanced accuracy pooled over all retained epochs of the participant's session (pooled.csv); networks: seed 'mean' row (mean over seeds)
statistics.round_decimals_source: [own]: zeros and ties of |d| are detected after rounding d to 12 decimals, so floating-point noise (~1e-16) does not hide an exact tie
statistics.sign_test: scipy.stats.binomtest(n_positive, n_nonzero, 0.5, alternative two-sided); direction = sign(n_positive - n_negative); Wilcoxon direction = sign(R+ - R-); different directions -> 'not robust' (P2-6)
statistics.hodges_lehmann: median of the Walsh averages (d_i + d_j) / 2, i <= j

bootstrap.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed), a fresh generator per method (identical resamples when n is equal)

statistics.holm_missing_p_source: [own]: the family stays 4; a comparison without a p-value enters Holm with p = 1 (conservative)
statistics.min_n_rule: per comparison: participants with valid results for both the method and the baseline (zeros included); fewer -> descriptive only (plan; P2-6)

permutation.description: per permutation p: rng = numpy.random.default_rng([seed, p]); for every file in sorted order its observed block targets are permuted across its blocks (evaluate.draw_shuffled_targets, n_perm 1); labels recomputed; folds fixed; the whole method refit in every fold; per-file BA from the pooled out-of-fold predictions of the file

network_input.role: network input of the P20 protocol: [M] broadband filter on the continuous record, no resampling
network_input.epoch_note: REQUIRED from PARADIGM.md: the trial window; epoch_samples_out = floor(length * fs)
network_input.source: [M] ../mas-ssvep-eeg-xai v1.0.4 (commit f725369) src/preprocessing/signal/filters.py l.9-50 (iirfilter Butterworth band-pass, then iirnotch, each filtfilt(b, a) with SciPy's default padding); scripts/build_windows.py l.4-5 (1-90 Hz order 4, notch 60 Hz Q 30); configs/pipeline_config.yaml (lowcut 1, highcut 90, notch 60, Q 30). span_tol 1e-3 = the filter-bank gate tolerance [own]
